name: Date! With Grace
source:
You finally managed to get a date with Grace, a cute girl from Crumble! A winner is you.

But is the date going to go your way? Or are you going to part ways in the end? And does it seem to you like she might not be entirely truthful about her intentions?

[from [url=https://velvetmoth.itch.io/date-with-grace]itch.io[/url]]
